title: What If the Sun Suddenly Disappeared?

scenes.text: What if the Sun suddenly vanished? For eight minutes, nobody would know.
Light takes eight minutes to reach us, and gravity travels just as fast. Earth keeps orbiting until then.
Then the sky goes dark, and Earth flies off in a straight line at roughly 67,000 miles an hour.
Within a week, the average surface falls below freezing. Within a year, it's below minus 70 Celsius.
Rain stops and oceans freeze from the top down, but deep water can stay liquid a very long time.
Even then, seafloor vents could keep life going, fed by Earth's heat, not the Sun.
